

// package main




fn source( events: &std::cell::RefCell<Vec<u8>>) -> (std::future::Ready<u8>) {
    
        

events.borrow_mut().push(1);



let ready = std::future::ready(7_u8)
;



return ready;



    
}
fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        
let events = std::cell::RefCell::new(Vec::<u8>::new())
;


let pending = async {

let first: u8;


first = (

source(&events)
).await

;


let ready = std::future::ready(first + 1)
;


let second = (ready).await

;



events.borrow_mut().push(second);




return second;



}

;



assert!(events.borrow().is_empty());



let mut pinned = Box::pin(pending)
;


let waker = std::task::Waker::noop()
;


let mut context = std::task::Context::from_waker(waker)
;


let handle = std::pin::Pin::as_mut(&mut pinned)
;


let observed = std::future::Future::poll(handle, &mut context)
;



assert_eq!(observed, std::task::Poll::Ready(8_u8));



let _released = drop(pinned)
;



assert_eq!(*events.borrow(), vec![1, 8]);



    
}
